children: DarkPulse moved its common stock from the OTCQB to the OTCID market after failing to meet the $0.01 minimum bid requirement.
OTC Markets notified DarkPulse of removal from the OTCQB and transfer to OTCID effective Oct 8, 2026.
Transfer resulted from failure to satisfy OTCQB minimum bid price requirement of $0.01 after grace period ended Oct 7, 2026.
Common stock continues to be quoted under the trading symbol DPLS on the OTCID market, effective market open Oct 8, 2026.
